Best value under ₹20,000 from this list: the Redmi 15C 5G is my top pick, then the Lava Bold N4 Pro 5G, then the Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G.

Phone	Price	Display	Camera	Battery
Redmi 15C 5G (4GB+128GB)	₹15,999	17.53 cm, up to 120Hz	50MP dual	6000mAh, 33W charging
Lava Bold N4 Pro 5G (6GB+128GB)	₹15,999	Not listed	50MP	6000mAh, 18W charging
Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G (4GB+128GB)	₹16,998	120Hz	50MP dual	6000mAh

Why this order:

Redmi 15C: same price as the Lava, with faster charging and a big 120Hz screen.
Lava Bold N4 Pro: 6GB RAM at the lowest price and a clean Android, but slower charging.
Samsung M17e: costs about ₹1,000 more, but adds water and dust protection (IP54) and 6 years of OS upgrades.

The OnePlus N6x (₹19,999 7000mAh, 120Hz) has the biggest battery, but it costs ₹4,000 more. The page did not list camera details for it.

Prices and specs come from one Hindustan Times list. Camera quality is not tested there, only the megapixels. Want me to look for hands-on camera reviews of these three?

Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
8:48 AM

Here's a gentle 3-day Jaipur plan for your parents, with a late start each day, a long lunch break and little walking uphill.

Day 1, the old city: City Palace, Jantar Mantar and Hawa Mahal (a photo from the road is enough if the stairs are tiring). Lunch nearby, then an easy stroll or auto ride through the Johari and Bapu Bazaar lanes for bangles and block prints.
Day 2, forts: Amer Fort in the morning, before the crowds. Use a jeep for the climb instead of walking. Stop at Panna Meena ka Kund on the way. Rest at the hotel in the afternoon, then see Jal Mahal and Nahargarh Fort at sunset.
Day 3, slow and local: Albert Hall Museum, then the Govind Dev Ji temple, then a relaxed lunch of dal baati churma. Finish with Birla Mandir in the evening, and shopping if there's time.

Tips: Late October is pleasant, but afternoons can still be warm, so keep the middle of the day indoors. Book a car with a driver for all three days. Staying near MI Road or the old city keeps the drives short.

Are your parents happy with some walking, or should I plan for as little as possible?
